extra.note: Plan 2C reuses Plan 2B's african_countries alias scan applied separately to first-author and senior-author (last) affiliations. AFRICAN_LED if either matches; NOT_AFRICAN_LED if both have data and neither matches; INSUFFICIENT if data missing. Inherits Plan 2A.1's pre-1995 NLM affiliation gap. Tier-P (Plan 2D) is the next classifier.
